regulatory_descriptor: A Non-Linked, Non-Participating, Individual Life Insurance Term Plan
key_benefits: Death Benefit (Sum Assured on Death) payable to nominee
Terminal Illness benefit — acceleration of death benefit, capped at Rs 2 crore
Waiver of future premiums on Accidental Total Permanent Disability (ATPD) or Terminal Illness
Return of Total Premiums Paid as Maturity Benefit — ONLY under the Life Shield ROP variant
Additional Accidental Death Benefit payout — ONLY under the Life Shield Plus variant
Death benefit payout as lump sum and/or monthly income for 5/10/20/30/40 years
Early Exit Value (Life Shield & Life Shield Plus variants)
Premium Holiday option (skip premiums for 1–3 years) and Auto Cover Continuance (defer up to 12 months)
riders_available: Accidental Permanent Total/Partial Disability Benefit Rider

eligibility.premium_payment_term: Single, Limited, Regular, or till Age 60
eligibility.note: Exact age/sum-assured boundary table not fully captured from this brochure parse — verify against policy document before asserting numeric limits.

key_terms.free_look_note: 30 days from receipt of the Policy Document.
key_terms.suicide_clause: On death by suicide within 12 months of commencement of risk or latest revival (whichever is later), nominee receives higher of 80% of Total Premiums Paid or Surrender/Termination Value; no other benefit. Policy must be in force.
key_terms.maturity_benefit_condition: Return of premiums at maturity applies ONLY to the Life Shield ROP variant; the base Life Shield variant has NO maturity benefit (pure term).
key_terms.tax_note: Tax benefits 'as per prevailing tax laws' — subject to change; GST applicable per prevailing tax laws.

claims_marketing_must_support: Any 'get your premiums back' / 'return of premium' / 'maturity benefit' claim is valid ONLY for the Life Shield ROP variant — must be variant-qualified.
Any accidental-death-payout claim is valid ONLY for the Life Shield Plus variant.
Terminal Illness benefit is an acceleration of (not additional to) the death benefit, capped at Rs 2 crore.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT position as an investment, savings, or wealth-creation product — it is non-linked, non-participating pure protection.
Do NOT use 'guaranteed returns' / 'bonus' language — the only money-back is return-of-premium on the ROP variant; there are no bonuses (non-par).
Do NOT present the base term cover as paying a maturity amount.
Tax benefits must not be stated as assured — always carry the 'subject to prevailing tax laws' caveat.
must_state: Plan UIN 116N198V07 (eTouch II; variant UINs 116N198V05/V06 also exist per variant)
Full regulatory descriptor: 'A Non-Linked, Non-Participating, Individual Life Insurance Term Plan'
Standard disclaimer to read the policy document / benefit illustration for full terms and exclusions
